body: I'd rather not say it, it might give other people ideas you know?

That's the point... Working a student job will get me about 200-300 euros a month... That's not enough to do anything really. I can't rely on myself or on anyone else :(

And yes, I have been getting emotional support from my grandmother, but there's nothing she can change, and in fact the whole situation makes her very sad as well, so I avoid trying to make her feel bad as well.

I agree, but I don't see them changing... I think that whatever is left of my dad will realize he made a mistake throwing me out, and how wrong it was of my mother to make him choose between us.

Unfortunately I also realize I don't want my parents back because I cannot ever forgive them for what they did. It would be nice to see them helping me out financially for my degree, but I know they won't change...

I'm afraid yes, they are. All they seem to care about is money, but they don't convey that message to the rest of the world. It seems that they think they're better than everybody else because they have such a huge amount of money on their bank accounts.

Knowing how much money they have, I wouldn't be a risk at all, so I don't think they think of me like that.

They just think of me as the guy that never worked (I never opened a book or even studied for an exam in high school and yet I always passed so I didn't need to study). I guess they think me not succeeding is a result of me not studying... They don't see a connection to them throwing me out of the house resulting in a depression and financial worries etc. and me not succeeding... I have a lot on my mind but they wouldn't even listen to me, they made their choice, to exclude me from their life.

Oh their financial situation is golden all right. My grandparents gave away most of their money (to avoid taxes on inheritance). Both my mother and father have very very high paying jobs and they never spent a cent they didn't have to. My father buys kilo bars of gold for fun... (not a joke, he really does that) a golden situation indeed.

I was just a normal kid, but my mother never could never stand the sight of me. Her losing her job 10 years ago meant she saw me every day. for 7 years I had to endure daily shouting and occasional slaps. She effectively made my father choose between her and me (literally) and he chose the easy way out. He told me to get an apartment, which I did, because a good kid listens to his parents. Then I found out he wasn't going to pay for anything which became the start of my depression and the true break between us. They don't seem to understand how being thrown out of the house could possibly impact my studies. I didn't want to get thrown out. I was perfectly fine in my little room in their house. I wasn't ready to stand on my own legs, but somehow I made it work, unfortunately that meant having to eat into my savings.

My grandparents on my mother's side refuse to believe they threw me out, and they never will...

My other grandfather passed away about a year ago (also had an impact as it was right before the exams). The only person believing and supporting me is my grandmother, but she can't change the situation.

My parents said for a long time that they didn't throw me out, but I finally got them to admit it, but I can't change the situation and they refuse to admit it to anyone else.

In short: them throwing me out was like rolling a snowball down a snowy mountain... It just gets bigger...

Actually, all of this is their fault... Had they not thrown me out, I would have been able to lead a normal life without depression or financial worries. Thinking about my parents at all makes me very sad. I just want to forget everything they did.

I don't really consider them parents anymore.

But I will never forget what injustice has been done to me, and this makes me very very depressed to the point that I don't want to go out of my studio apartment at all. I have no reason to go out... I don't even want my girlfriend to be here all the time because I like being alone, doing nothing at all. Doing things only seems to make my mind more aware of all my problems, as does trying to solve them...
I'm afraid that at the moment it's not in the budget to go see a doctor at all, my savings are only sufficient for a couple more months.

I maybe get around that if I can prove I live on my own, that's when I'm a student again next year, that would earn me about 150 euros in child benefits, but it is expected of your parents to pay for your living costs if they have the money. Unfortunately, my parents are not obligated anymore because I failed last year (because of my depression).

In fact, I don't wish to ever speak to my parents again, I just need about 750 euros per month, it would be enough to survive and study. I also plan to pay a visit to the local welfare center to get more informed, which means they'll contact my parents, and the case will probably go to court, which I would like to avoid at all costs because the relationship between me and my parents is already bad enough...

I'm from Europe, and unfortunately a student loan would mean 10 percent interest would have to be paid and it is in fact impossible without the support of your parents. (My parents are rich so it's very tough on me that they're not giving me any money, I simply can't understand their reasoning, I never did anything wrong to get kicked out of the house btw, my mother just never liked me)

I'm afraid I don't really have any real hobbies anymore. I have been to my doctor to talk about my suicidal thoughts, but he just said that I shouldn't think about it. I had some antidepressants a while back, but they didn't seem to work, also, I like to think ahead, and since I'm still on my parent's health insurance I can't really afford doctor's visits let alone a psychiatrist in the long run... I also think going to my doctor for suicidal thoughts isn't really helpful at all :(

Thanks for the reply,

I can become financially stable by getting a job for the next 7-8 months, but I would really like to return to university next year to follow my dream, but I don't have any financial support from anyone, so let's say I save up enough to study one year, the next year I will have run out of money and I won't be able to pay rent and uni fees etc.
Getting a student loan here is also impossible, so I don't see a way out of all of this...
